meta.name: NapCat WebUI Design DNA
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from NapCat WebUI (napcat-webui-frontend) — ACG/cherry-blossom aesthetic with glassmorphism, motion/react animations, HeroUI components, sakura/frost color palette

primary.role: Sakura pink - dominant accent, CTAs, focus rings, interactive elements

secondary.role: Frost blue - supporting accent, secondary actions, info states

accent.role: Deep rose - hover/active primary, destructive actions

neutral.usage: Pink-tinted neutrals for light mode; inverted for dark mode

surface.background: gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-white to-pink-50 (light) / dark:from-gray-900 dark:via-gray-800 dark:to-gray-900
surface.card: bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/40 with backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/40 dark:border-white/10
surface.elevated: bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/30 hover:bg-white/80 dark:hover:bg-black/20 with shadow-sm

color.contrast_strategy: subtle layers with glassmorphism — semi-transparent cards over gradient backgrounds, white/black text with opacity modulation

font_families.heading: 'Quicksand', 'Nunito', 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
font_families.body: 'Quicksand', 'Nunito', 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Rounded geometric sans (Quicksand/Nunito) for friendly ACG feel; JetBrains Mono for code/terminal; letter-spacing 0.02em body, negative for headings; -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased

spacing.content_density: comfortable with generous breathing room; cards use p-4/p-5/p-6; sections gap-4/gap-6
spacing.section_rhythm: Consistent 4-unit (16px) base rhythm; md:gap-4 (16px) / lg:gap-6 (24px) for grid gaps; py-5 (20px) vertical section padding

layout.grid_system: CSS Grid + Flexbox hybrid; 8-col mobile / 3-col md / 6-col lg for dashboards; sidebar 16rem (256px) fixed
layout.max_content_width: 1000px (md:max-w-[1000px]) for main content; full-width for login/pure layouts
layout.alignment_tendency: centered for auth/pure layouts; left-aligned grid for dashboards; sticky top breadcrumbs

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px border-white/40 dark:border-white/10 on glass cards; no hard borders elsewhere
shape.divider_style: hairline via backdrop-blur edges; HeroUI divider component for lists

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused with backdrop-blur; layering via transparency not heavy shadows

iconography.style: Lucide React (Lu*) icons — clean 2px stroke, rounded caps; react-icons for brand icons (Gi, Bi, Io, Md)
iconography.stroke_weight: 2px equivalent (w-5 h-5 default, w-4 h-4 small, w-6 h-6 large)
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide React for UI; react-icons for brand/logos

motion.easing: spring (stiffness: 120-150, damping: 15-20) for layout; ease-out for micro-interactions
motion.entrance_pattern: fade-up (opacity 0→1, y: 20→0) + scale (0.95→1) with spring; staggered children via AnimatePresence
motion.philosophy: playful spring physics for layout; snappy functional for interactions; motion/redux (framer-motion) for complex choreography

components.button_style: HeroUI Button variants: shadow (primary CTA), flat (secondary), light (ghost), bordered; pill radius (full) for primary; size lg with py-7; startContent icons; isLoading state
components.input_style: HeroUI Input: backdrop-blur-xl bg-transparent innerWrapper; shadow-xl inputWrapper with focus glow; radius lg; startContent icons; isClearable for token fields
components.card_style: HeroUI Card: backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/40 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm; bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/40; hover elevation; optional background image overlay with opacity-30
components.navigation_pattern: Collapsible sidebar (16rem→0) with spring animation; breadcrumbs with motion stagger; mobile overlay backdrop-blur
components.modal_style: HeroUI Dialog/Modal with backdrop-blur; HoverEffectCard for login (3D tilt on hover); spring entrance
components.list_style: Network item cards: grid layout, large mono count + label; System status: grid 2-col with icon headers; UsagePie canvas charts
components.component_notes: HoverEffectCard: 3D perspective tilt (rotateX/rotateY) + moving gradient light blob on hover; PageBackground: static gradient blobs (primary/secondary/pink) with massive blur; Toast: react-hot-toast top-right

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Cherry blossoms in digital frost — ACG aesthetic meets developer tooling
aesthetic.era_influence: Modern web (2020s) with anime/moe culture influences; glassmorphism 2.0

visual_language.complexity: moderate — rich but not cluttered; breathing room via glass cards
visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents — gradient blobs, 3D tilt cards, animated breadcrumbs, scrollbar theming
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous — cards have internal padding, grid gaps 16-24px, section padding 20px+
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: balanced — sidebar + main content; dashboard cards equal weight; login centered hero
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal — entrance animations, hover discoveries, layered depth
visual_language.contrast_level: medium — relies on opacity layers not high contrast; dark mode inverts surfaces
visual_language.texture_usage: glassmorphism (backdrop-blur), gradient mesh blobs, subtle noise via saturation

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + typographic hierarchy + spatial isolation (cards)
composition.balance_type: asymmetric — sidebar fixed, main fluid; dashboard grid balanced
composition.flow_direction: vertical primary (sidebar→content), horizontal secondary (breadcrumbs, card grids)
composition.grouping_strategy: cards as containers; grid for peer items; sections separated by gap
composition.negative_space_role: breathing room between cards; focus isolation for modals/login

imagery.photo_treatment: custom background image upload (base64) with overlay opacity-30 object-contain
imagery.illustration_style: ACG/moe logo (NapCat cat), gradient blob art
imagery.graphic_elements: gradient orbs (primary/secondary/pink), moving light blob on hover cards
imagery.pattern_usage: none explicit; glassmorphism creates implied pattern
imagery.image_shape: full-bleed background; logo 7em height on login

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate visual — 3D tilt on cards, light blob follows cursor, spring scale on buttons
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: card: perspective rotateX/rotateY + gradient light follows mouse; button: shadow elevation + scale; input: focus glow ring
interaction_feel.transition_personality: spring physics (stiffness 120-150) for layout; snappy ease-out for micro
interaction_feel.loading_style: PageLoading full-screen overlay; Skeleton cards for dashboard; Suspense boundaries per route
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: high — every interactive element has hover/tap/transition choreography

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: friendly technical — '猫猫日志', '喵~', emoji in hints
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: casual developer — Chinese labels with English terms mixed
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative with playful twist — '登录' with logo animation, '切换主题', '重启进程'
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: helpful not alarming — toast errors, confirm dialogs for destructive actions

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS (disable motion spring, keep glassmorphism)
overview.primary_technology: CSS (Tailwind) + motion/react (Framer Motion) + Canvas 2D (UsagePie charts) + HeroUI

background_effects.description: Three large radial gradient blobs (primary-200/40, secondary-200/40, pink-200/30) with massive blur (90-110px) positioned at corners, static but imply depth

3d_elements.description: HoverEffectCard uses CSS 3D transforms (perspective 1000px, rotateX/rotateY up to ±5deg) with a moving gradient light blob that follows cursor

params.lighting: moving gradient blob (from-primary-400 to-secondary-400) follows cursor

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: route mount (Suspense), sidebar open/close, breadcrumb items

text_effects.description: HeroUI title component supports color='violet' for gradient text; login page 'Web Login' split with violet accent

cursor_effects.description: On HoverEffectCard, a gradient radial blur blob follows cursor position within card bounds
cursor_effects.technology: CSS absolute positioned div + React mouse tracking

image_effects.description: User-uploaded background image rendered full-bleed behind layout with opacity-30 object-contain

canvas_drawings.description: UsagePie component renders CPU/memory donut charts using Canvas 2D with animated sweep

visual_effects.composite_notes: The design layers: 1) Static gradient mesh background (CSS), 2) Glass cards with backdrop-blur (CSS), 3) 3D tilt cards on hover (CSS 3D + React), 4) Magnetic light blob follows cursor (React + CSS), 5) Spring animations for layout transitions (motion/react), 6) Canvas pie charts for data viz, 7) Themed scrollbars (CSS), 8) Custom background image overlay (CSS). All effects are lightweight — no WebGL, no heavy JS animation libraries beyond motion/react. HeroUI provides accessible component primitives. Dark mode inverts surfaces and adjusts blob colors. Performance is good on modern browsers; fallback is static CSS (disable motion, keep glass).
